label: Small test — XYZ-JP225 vs JP225 (1x)
description: A small, 1x preset to test XYZ-JP225/USDC:USDC vs MT5 JP225: 0.01 units per level ~ 1.6 JP225 lots (about 680 USD; hedged by value through the project's FX pair); two grid levels per side, so at most 0.02 units each way; isolated margin; daily loss capped at 25 USD and 10,000 USD of volume per leg. Sizes assume a broker whose minimum lot is the usual one — Save checks them against the market the bot reports; start in DRY RUN.
